adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, new attendee rows are persisted via `await prisma.booking.update({ ... attendees: { createMany: ... } })` (around lines 92-124). After that commit, the code calls `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` without any `try/catch` or transaction wrapper. If the calendar-provider update throws/rejects, the mutation will error (raw 500) while the DB already contains the new attendees, and `sendAddGuestsEmails` is never reached—creating a verifiable partial-success/inconsistent state based on the diff.
